001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign;

003import java.util.List;
004
005import java.awt.Color;
006
007import org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11;
008
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.BaseCustomUIPanelPlugin;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.graphics.SpriteAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.input.InputEventAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.PositionAPI;
014
015public class ExampleCustomUIPanel extends BaseCustomUIPanelPlugin {
016
017        private PositionAPI p;
018        private SpriteAPI sprite;
019
020        private float mouseX, mouseY;
021        
022        public ExampleCustomUIPanel() {
023                sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite("graphics/ships/wolf/wolf_base.png");
024        }
025
026        public void positionChanged(PositionAPI position) {
027                p = position;
028                mouseX = p.getX() + p.getWidth() / 2f;
029                mouseY = p.getY() + p.getHeight() / 2f;
030        }
031        
032        public void advance(float amount) {
033                if (p == null) return;
034                
035        }
036
037        public void processInput(List<InputEventAPI> events) {
038                if (p == null) return;
039                
040                for (InputEventAPI event : events) {
041                        if (event.isConsumed()) continue;
042                        
043                        if (event.isMouseMoveEvent()) {
044                                if (p.containsEvent(event)) {
045                                        mouseX = event.getX();
046                                        mouseY = event.getY();
047                                        //System.out.println("x,y: " + x + "," + y);
048                                } else {
049                                        mouseX = p.getX() + p.getWidth() / 2f;
050                                        mouseY = p.getY() + p.getHeight() / 2f;
051                                }
052                        }
053                }
054        }
055
056        public void render(float alphaMult) {
057                if (p == null) return;
058                
059                float x = p.getX();
060                float y = p.getY();
061                float w = p.getWidth();
062                float h = p.getHeight();
063                
064                GL11.glDisable(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D);
065                GL11.glEnable(GL11.GL_BLEND);
066                GL11.glBlendFunc(GL11.GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL11.GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
067
068                Color color = Color.cyan;
069                
070                GL11.glColor4ub((byte)color.getRed(),
071                                                (byte)color.getGreen(),
072                                                (byte)color.getBlue(),
073                                                (byte)(color.getAlpha() * alphaMult * 0.25f));
074                
075                GL11.glBegin(GL11.GL_QUADS);
076                {
077                        GL11.glVertex2f(x, y);
078                        GL11.glVertex2f(x, y + h);
079                        GL11.glVertex2f(x + w, y + h);
080                        GL11.glVertex2f(x + w, y);
081                }
082                GL11.glEnd();
083                
084//              mouseX = Mouse.getX();
085//              mouseY = Mouse.getY();
086                sprite.setAlphaMult(alphaMult);
087                sprite.renderAtCenter(mouseX, mouseY);
088                
089                //throw new RuntimeException("wefklhwefw");
090                
091        }
092
093        public void renderBelow(float alphaMult) {
094                
095        }
096
097        @Override
098        public void buttonPressed(Object buttonId) {
099                super.buttonPressed(buttonId);
100        }
101        
102        
103
104}
